metadata.scope: Make the /admin/schema diff-review and stableKey-resolve interaction intuitive in the apps/web presentation layer only. Move the alias-assign form from the panel bottom to an inline expansion directly under the clicked diff card, add a page-level purpose guide and per-action contextual help, and present technical terms (stableKey/questionId/alias/resolve/backfill/recompute) with plain-Japanese primary labels and the technical name in parentheses. No API, D1 schema, Google Form, or endpoint surface changes.
metadata.runtime_boundary: This wave implemented the apps/web presentation-layer UX change, focused component/unit tests, web typecheck, design-token verification, apps/api non-touch check, Phase 12 strict outputs, and aiworkflow-requirements sync. Authenticated staging visual evidence, screenshots, commit, push, and PR remain user-gated.
metadata.real_cause: apps/web presentation-layer information-design gap. The schema-diff feature and its API contract (POST /admin/schema/aliases 200/202 branch, bulk resolve, rollback, undo, recompute) are already complete. The pain is that clicking a diff card opens the assign form at the far bottom of the panel (causality invisible), the technical vocabulary is unexplained, and there is no per-action 'what does this accomplish' help.
